The same settings.json as the Mac, Windows and Linux apps. Rules you write yourself are kept in it; the other apps ignore them.
Off by default. fxclip otherwise stores nothing but the counter. Kept on this phone, never sent anywhere, and emptied with the button below.
Offer the apps I share to most often
fxclip removes the tracking parameters added to the links you share: utm_*, fbclid, YouTube\'s si, Amazon referrals, and more. Nothing leaves your phone.
In any app, tap Share and pick “Clean link”. fxclip offers the apps you share to most often, or the full share sheet. Telegram receives the preview version, so the post shows in full.
Select a link in any text field and pick “Clean link” in the menu that appears. It is replaced on the spot. Android often hides these entries behind the three dots.
Add the quick-settings tile or the home-screen widget: one tap cleans the link on the clipboard. Opening fxclip does it too.
